title: Learning at the Right Pace: Adaptive Data Scheduling Improves LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.22305v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve remarkable reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. However, existing RL post-training commonly relies on uniform data sampling, which ignores the semantic structure of the training data and the evolving capability of the training policy. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Data Scheduling (ADS), a dual-level data scheduling framework that combines adaptive sampling across semantic clusters with policy-boundary sample selection. At the cluster level, ADS organizes samples according to semantic patterns and adapts the inter-cluster sampling distribution to prioritize clusters within the policy's current reach. At the sample level, ADS tracks prompts near the policy's capability boundary within each cluster to obtain informative relative advantages. translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过强化学习（RL）后训练获得了卓越的推理能力。然而，现有的RL后训练通常依赖均匀的数据采样，这忽略了训练数据的语义结构以及训练策略不断演进的能力。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了自适应数据调度，这是一个双层的数据调度框架，将跨语义簇的自适应采样与策略边界样本选择相结合。在簇级别，ADS根据语义模式组织样本，并调整簇间的采样分布，以优先选择策略当前能力可及范围内的簇。在样本级别，ADS在每个簇内追踪接近策略能力边界的提示，以获取信息更丰富的相对优势信号。在三个大语言模型和七个推理基准上的实验结果表明，ADS提升了平均
tldr: 提出双层自适应数据调度框架ADS，通过在语义簇间自适应采样并选取策略能力边界附近的样本，有效提升了大语言模型强化学习后训练的推理性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes ADS, a dual-level adaptive data scheduling framework that combines adaptive sampling across semantic clusters with policy-boundary sample selection to improve LLM reinforcement learning post-training.
